v4.6.12 — CRITICAL: start_bot has been dead code since v4.6.6

🐛 FIXED
• RUN BOT did nothing for Universe scripts AND any local (non-cloud) bot. When v4.6.6 added _is_non_trading_script as a precheck-bypass helper, the method body was accidentally inserted BETWEEN the precheck return and the rest of start_bot — so the entire launch chain (cloud routing + QProcess setup + .start()) became dead code inside _is_non_trading_script after its `return False`. Cloud bots' Restart still worked because that goes through _cloud_stop → _cloud_start, bypassing start_bot. But anyone clicking RUN BOT on a stopped universe script or any local bot saw the precheck pass, then nothing — no logs, no error, just silence.

Launch logic is now back inside start_bot where it belongs; _is_non_trading_script moved to its own method below.
